hub.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
hub.text: Exam-floor bookings, lift tokens, floor kit. State which, or stand aside for the next in line.

options.text: I need clearance for the forge tier.
Any word from the exam floor?
Grimalkin wrote my load class. About the token.
A vial of tempering oil, if you're headed to the floor. (12 gold)

options._comment: #438 EQUIPMENT GAPS, the two forge-tier retail rows. APPENDED LAST and gated on `pallass_entry_stamped` exactly like the tempering-oil arm above, so they are HIDDEN at every fixture that has not stamped in -- the same shape that kept the oil arm off the earlier pins. Prices are the catalog prices (items.json guardsmans_pike 18, weighted_apron 12), posted-price like everything else this clerk sells: he records fees, he does not haggle.
options.text: One of the wall-company pikes off the rack. (18 gold)
A bench apron, the weighted kind. (12 gold)

pike_sold.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
pike_sold.text: Rack stock, stamped at the collar. The stamp is what you are buying. An unstamped haft gets you turned around at the lift.

apron_sold.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
apron_sold.text: Lead in the hem. It hangs straight and stops a spark. It is not armour, which is the answer if anyone asks.

tempering_sold.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
tempering_sold.text: Posted price, paid in full. Work it into the edge the night before you need it. Questions of application go to the smiths on the floor. I sell the flask and record the fee.

permit_intro.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_intro.text: Five gold books a slot on the exam floor, same day, posted price. Grimalkin reads you at the far end of this office. The forge tier carries loads all day, and he writes down whether you can.

permit_filed_reaction.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_filed_reaction.text: Booked. Chalk your hands at the bucket before you go to him. He notices.

permit_status.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_status.text: Booked and waiting on his read. This window cuts your token after he writes your load class.

collect_stamp.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
collect_stamp.text: Your load class is on the slate. Three gold for the lift token, posted price, cut to the class he wrote.

stamp_reaction.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
stamp_reaction.text: Cut and stamped with your class. The lift answers to it now. Lose it and you sit his read again.
